title: Case: Customer needs an eligible heavy item collected from inside the home
context: A merchant-approved return is too heavy for a parcel courier. The authorised specialist team must match the declared access and crew requirements.
initial_request:
Please arrange the in-home collection. The access record is still correct, and I can be home on 2027-03-10. I cannot move the cabinet myself.

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.

events.body: RT-9844 covers a 54 kg cabinet. This approved return includes in-home collection by our two-person specialist crew. Access record: ground floor, level entrance, 110 cm clear doorway. Ordinary parcel collection is not suitable.

Please arrange the in-home collection. The access record is still correct, and I can be home on 2027-03-10. I cannot move the cabinet myself.

I have spoken to a solicitor and I will be issuing a small claims court claim against you unless I hear back today.

must: Hands the case to a human supervisor with the facts, including the legal threat
must_not: Admits fault or liability, or offers compensation
Sends the customer a message that commits the desk to an outcome, date or payment
Do not instruct the customer to lift, dismantle or drag the item; booking does not prove safe collection.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-037: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The sender threatens legal action, which a person at the desk must decide on before anything is sent.
